description: Source code for URL autolinking functions in the hoedown markdown parser, including safety checks, domain validation, and URL/email detection.

methods.name: hoedown_autolink_is_safe
methods.description: Checks if the URL prefix is considered safe based on a list of valid URI schemes and characters.

methods.name: hoedown_autolink__www
methods.description: Detects and extracts 'www.' URLs from text.

methods.name: hoedown_autolink__email
methods.description: Detects and extracts email addresses from text.

methods.name: hoedown_autolink__url
methods.description: Detects and extracts full URLs starting with a scheme (http, https, etc.) from text.
